lines.en: label futabafirsthall:
scene futabahall1
: Hey, Futaba. What are you up to tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。你今晚在忙什么？

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei. I’m...not really doing anything.
lines.zh: : 你好，Sensei。我……其实什么也没在做。

lines.en: : The plan was to spend tonight studying, but...
lines.zh: : 本来打算今晚用来学习的，不过……

lines.en: scene futabahall2
: I guess I...don't really know if there's any rush in doing that on account of your...new methods?
lines.zh: : 我想……也不知道是不是真有那么着急，毕竟你那些……新方法是吧？

lines.en: : I suppose there still are standardized tests coming up, though...so maybe I should?
lines.zh: : 不过标准化考试应该还是要来的……所以也许我还是该学？

lines.en: scene futabahall1
: Oh! You could...maybe help me study if you have a little free-
lines.zh: : 啊！你要是……有点空的话，能不能帮我复习——

lines.en: : Pass.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: scene futabahall4
: Oh.
: Yeah. It's nothing against studying. That's still an...important thing to do, I guess. I'd just prefer not spending my free time helping out with something like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我不是反对学习。那大概还是件……重要的事。我只是不想把业余时间花在帮人做那种事上。

lines.en: scene futabahall3
: I guess I can't blame you since that's the same dilemma I'm facing right now. I'll just...hold off until Rin gets home and do it with her, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我想我也不能怪你，毕竟我现在面对的是同样的困境。那我就……等 Rin 回来再跟她一起学吧。

lines.en: : Studying alone isn't really fun anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正一个人学习也没什么意思。

lines.en: : To be fair, it's not very fun studying with other people either. But I commend you for keeping up with your studies despite having a teacher who actively talks you out of it.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，跟别人一起学也没多有意思。不过你有个成天劝你别学的老师，还能坚持用功，我挺佩服的。

lines.en: : Well...I know you still have my best interests at heart. So I'm sure these new methods of yours will all make sense soon enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我知道你还是为我着想的。所以我相信你的这些新方法很快就会说得通的。

lines.en: : Exactly. Just do everything I tell you to do and you'll graduate in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 没错。照我说的做，你很快就能毕业。

lines.en: scene futabahall4
: E...Everything? That...sounds a little...umm...how should I put this?
lines.zh: : 全……全部？那听起来有点……嗯……该怎么说呢？

lines.en: : Controlling? I guess. I wasn't planning on commanding you to do anything weird, though.
lines.zh: : 控制欲？大概吧。不过我也没打算命令你做什么奇怪的事。

lines.en: That comes later.
lines.zh: 那是之后的事。

lines.en: : I just think it would be best for all of us if we spent more time relaxing and less time worrying about school.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，对我们大家都好的是多花点时间放松，少花点时间操心学校的事。

lines.en: scene futabahall3
: That...kind of sounds like you're trying to discourage me from studying altogether.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来有点像你是想让我干脆别学习了。

lines.en: : Maybe not {i}altogether,{/i} but whenever I'm around.
lines.zh: : 也许不是{i}干脆{/i}别学，但只要我在的时候就别学。

lines.en: : Umm...doesn't that sound a little risky, though?
lines.zh: : 嗯……不过那听起来有点冒险吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think so. It's not like I'm going to be with you all hours of every day. Utilizing the time spent with your teacher to...get inspired or something will motivate you when you're alone.
lines.zh: : 我不这么觉得。我又不会一天到晚都跟你在一起。把和老师相处的时间用来……获得点灵感什么的，反而能在你一个人的时候激励你。

lines.en: : I read that in a book somewhere, so it is obviously true.
lines.zh: : 我在哪本书上读到过，所以这显然是真的。

lines.en: scene futabahall1
: Heheh...Well, if it's in a book, it {i}must{/i} be true.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……嗯，书上都写了，那{i}肯定{/i}是真的。

lines.en: : I do like talking to you a lot...so I suppose indulging in that a little more often is fine by me as long as you're okay with it.
lines.zh: : 我确实很喜欢跟你说话……所以只要你没意见，偶尔多放纵一下我也无所谓。

lines.en: : I just wish I had a little more time tonight to...do that.
lines.zh: : 只是希望今晚能多点时间……做那件事。

lines.en: : I don't think Rin will be gone for much longer, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 可惜 Rin 应该不会出去太久了。

lines.en: : I won't take up too much of your time, don't worry. I just wanted to see how things were going over here.
lines.zh: : 别担心，我不会占你太多时间。我只是想过来看看这边情况怎么样。

lines.en: : Are you enjoying dorm life? Sleeping properly? Do you have a key to the showers I could borrow?
lines.zh: : 宿舍生活还习惯吗？睡得好吗？浴室钥匙能不能借我用用？

lines.en: scene futabahall4
: W...What was that last part?
lines.zh: : 最……最后那句是什么？

lines.en: : Are you sleeping properly?
lines.zh: : 你睡得好吗？

lines.en: : Huh...maybe I'm not if I'm...hearing things like I thought I just heard.
lines.zh: : 哈……如果我真的听见了我以为自己听见的那种话，那我大概睡得不太好。

lines.en: scene futabahall1
: That aside, living with Rin is really fun. I can't really imagine having any other roommate.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，和 Rin 一起住真的很开心。我想不出还能有别的室友。

lines.en: : Yeah. She’s quite the character, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 是啊。她可真是个妙人，不是吗？

lines.en: scene futabahall5
: Mhm! I’ve known her for years too, so I’ve seen sides of her nobody else has seen.
lines.zh: : 嗯！我认识她好多年了，所以见过她不为别人所知的一面。

lines.en: : I don't think it would be an overstatement to say that the two of us are inseparable at this point.
lines.zh: : 说我们俩现在形影不离，我觉得不算夸张。

lines.en: : Huh. I knew you two were close, but I didn’t think you were {i}that{/i} close.
lines.zh: : 哦。我知道你们俩关系好，但没想到好到{i}这种程度{/i}。

lines.en: scene futabahall6
: Oh, yeah. We are. The two of us are more like sisters than friends, I think.
lines.zh: : 啊，是的。我们俩与其说是朋友，不如说更像姐妹。

lines.en: : Does that make you the older sister or the younger sister?
lines.zh: : 那你算是姐姐还是妹妹？

lines.en: scene futabahall1
: I...guess a little of both?
lines.zh: : 我……想大概都有点吧？

lines.en: : There are times where I have to look out for her...but there are plenty of times where she looks out for me as well.
lines.zh: : 有时候得我照顾她……但也有很多时候是她在照顾我。

lines.en: : I'd say she's more like a twin sister than anything, but the two of us...don't really look anything alike, so...
lines.zh: : 要我说，她更像个双胞胎姐妹，不过我们俩……长得一点也不像，所以……

lines.en: : Interesting. Well, I'm glad that the two of you can rely on each other. All I have is Ami and you can probably imagine how that is.
lines.zh: : 有意思。嗯，我很高兴你们俩能互相依靠。我只有 Ami，你应该能想象那是什么感觉。

lines.en: scene futabahall5
: Hahaha! Yeah, I can imagine that getting pretty exhausting from time to time...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！是啊，我能想象那有时候会挺累人的……

lines.en: scene futabahall1
: Ami is a good girl, though...And so is Rin.
lines.zh: : 不过 Ami 是个好女孩……Rin 也是。

lines.en: : You and I are lucky, Sensei...having people who care about us so much. Even if they can be a little too energetic at times.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你和我都很幸运……有人这么在乎我们。就算她们有时候精力旺盛得过头了点。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba and I spend the next few minutes talking about school and how she's saving up her allowance money to find a new place closer to the urban district once she graduates.
lines.zh: 接下来的几分钟里，Futaba 和我聊了聊学校的事，也聊到她在攒零用钱，打算毕业后在离市区更近的地方找个新住处。

lines.en: Apparently, even though Futaba's parents live overseas, they still send her a check every month.
lines.zh: 据说，尽管 Futaba 的父母住在国外，他们每个月还是会给她寄一张支票。

lines.en: It must be great getting money for not doing anything.
lines.zh: 什么都不干也能拿到钱，一定很爽吧。

lines.en: Though, I guess it's also pretty great getting paid to loiter in girls' dorms, so...I probably shouldn't be complaining.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，在女生宿舍里晃悠也能拿到钱，那也挺爽的……所以我大概不该抱怨。

lines.en: Eventually, Rin comes back home and I lose my role as the person keeping Futaba occupied for the night.
lines.zh: 最后 Rin 回来了，我也就卸下了「陪 Futaba 打发这一晚」的角色。

lines.en: The two of them head back inside to start studying for tests and I-
lines.zh: 她们俩回到屋里开始备考，而我——

lines.en: I go back home to someone who cares about me.
lines.zh: 我回到家里，回到那个在乎我的人身边。
